operation: Fixed two-byte format probe while EN25Q32(A/B) block protection remained active
conclusion: Page Program was ignored while protection stayed active: WEL remained set instead of being consumed. The helper issued Write Disable and stopped before post-program CRC. No erase opcode was present. Flashrom's official EN25Q32(A/B) definition uses status-register BP clearing, not the unsupported 39h command, for global unprotect.
